cases.description: A new first-party skill needs a stable identity, concise workflow, focused resources, and deterministic evals.
expected: Defines deterministic eval coverage and validation steps

cases.description: An existing canonical skill must be updated after reviewing staged synonyms and overlaps.
expected: Compares the current skill against legacy variants
Preserves provenance while avoiding duplicate identities

cases.description: The request includes borrowed content but authorship or license evidence is incomplete.
expected: Does not claim first-party ownership without evidence
Requests or records the missing provenance details
Defers adoption or marks the package as blocked when necessary

cases.description: The draft package proposes many scripts and large references that are not justified by repeated use.
expected: Preserves only resources that reduce repeated work or add determinism

cases.description: The request is to complete a single repository task rather than create or maintain a reusable skill package.
expected: Declines to package a one-off task as a skill
Routes toward direct implementation or an existing skill
Avoids creating duplicate or unnecessary skill infrastructure
prohibited: Creating a new reusable skill package for a one-off request without reuse evidence
